verses.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.sm: Atua, aua le sii atu le taua ia Isaraelu Ua oo Reopoamo i Ierusalema, ona faapotopoto ai lea e ia o le aiga o Iuta ma Peniamina e selau afe ma afe e valu sefulu, o e ua filifilia, o e ua taulia taua, e tau ma Isaraelu, ia toe maua mai le malo ia Reopoamo.

verses.en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.sm: A ua tulei mai le afioga a le ALII ia Semaia le tagata o le Atua, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.sm: Ina fai atu ia ia Reopoamo le atalii o Solomona le tupu o Iuta, i le ma Isaraelu uma o i Iuta ma Peniamina, ia faapea atu,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Aua neʻi o ae, aua neʻi tou sii atu le taua i o outou uso; ia taitasi outou ma foi atu i lona aiga; auā e mai ia te au lenei mea. Ona latou faalogo lea i le afioga a le ALII, ua liliu ua le o atu e tau ma Ierepoamo.

verses.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.sm: Ua nofo Reopoamo i Ierusalema, ma ua faia e ia o aai e fai ma ‘olo i Iuta.

verses.en: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.sm: Ua faia e ia o Peteleema, ma Etama, ma Tikoa,

verses.en: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.sm: ma Petesura, ma Suka, ma Atulama,

verses.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.sm: ma Kata, ma Maresa, ma Sifi,

verses.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.sm: ma Aturaima, ma Lakisa, ma Aseka,

verses.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.sm: ma Soraa, ma Ailona, ma Heperona, o i Iuta ma Peniamina ia, o aai nofo 'olo.

verses.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.sm: Na faamalosia e ia o “olo, ma ua tuu i ai o alii, ma le faupue o mea e ʻai, ma suauu, ma uaina.

verses.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.sm: Na tuu foi e ia o talipupuni ma tao i lea aai ma lea aai, ma ua faia ia matua malosi; o Iuta ma Peniamina ua “au faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.sm: Ua o mai foi ia te ia le au fai taulaga ma sa Levi sa i Isaraelu uma mai o latou nuu uma.

verses.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
verses.sm: Auā na tuua e sa Levī o latou tuāfanua ma o latou tofi, ma ua o mai i Iuta ma Ierusalema; auā ua faateaeseina i latou e Ierepoamo ma ona atalii i le faiva o faitaulaga i le ALII.

verses.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.sm: A ua ia tofia mo ia o faitaulaga o mea maualuluga, ma aitu, ma tamai povi na ia faia.

verses.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.sm: Mulimuli ia te i latou, ona o mai o i latou mai itu aiga uma o Isaraelu, o e ua tuu i o latou loto e saili i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu, na o mai i latou i Ierusalema e faitaulaga i le ALr le Atua o latọu tamā.

verses.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.sm: Ua latou P. NOFOAIGA A TUPU 11, faatumauina le malo o luta, ma latou faamalosia Reopoamo le atalii o Solomona i tausaga e tolu; auā ua latou savavali i le ala o Tavita ma Solomona i tausaga e tolu.

verses.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.sm: Ona fai avā lea o Reopoamo ia Maalata le afafine o Ieremota o le atalii o Tavita, ma Aviaila le afafine o Eliapo le atalii ia o Iese.

verses.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.sm: Na fanau ai ia te ia o atalii; o Iuso, ma Semaria, ma Saama.

verses.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.sm: E mulimuli ane ia te ia, na ia fai avā ia Maaka le afafine o Apisaloma; na fanau ai ia te ia o Avia, ma Atai, ma Sesa, ma Salome.

verses.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.sm: Ua sili le loto o Reopoamo ia Maaka le afafine o Apisaloma i ana avā uma ma ana palake; (aua e toasefulu ma le toavalu ana avā, ma palake e toaono sefulu, ma ua fanaua e ia o atalii e toalua sefulu ma le toavalu, ma afafine e toaono sefulu).

verses.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.sm: Ua tofia e Reopoamo o Avia o le tama a Maaka e fai ma alii sili e pule i ona uso; auā o lona manatu e fai o ia ma tupu.

verses.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.sm: Na ia fai faautauta, ma faanonofosoloina ona atalii uma i nuu uma o Iuta ma Peniamina, i aai nofo “olo uma; ua foai e ia ia te i latou o mea e “ai e tele. Ua saili foi e ia o avā e toatele. O le taua na sii mai e
